opus.problem: The clue says the later wheat was spared, but Exodus 9:31 mentions only flax and barley. The wheat being spared is in Exodus 9:32, so this part of the clue is not supported by its cited verse.
The clue sets the dream 'near Gideon's camp', but in the verse Gideon went to the Midianite camp and overheard the dream there. The setting is inaccurate.
